ERR_CONN_SYSTEM.message: Stream {connector} belongs to the board and cannot be removed

ERR_CONN_TARGETS_FULL.message: Stream {connector} has no room for another connection or subscriber

ERR_CONN_TOO_LONG.message: {len} bytes are too long for stream {connector} (at most {max})

ERR_CONN_QUEUE_FULL.message: Stream {connector} is sending faster than its connections carry: {len} bytes dropped

ERR_CONN_FULL.message: No room for stream {connector}: every slot is taken

ERR_CONN_POOL_FULL.message: No room for stream {connector}: it needs {size} bytes of buffer and {free} are free
ERR_CONN_POOL_FULL.hint: Make its buffer smaller, or remove a stream that has one.

ERR_CONN_NO_RX.message: Stream {connector} keeps nothing that comes in and forwards nothing
ERR_CONN_NO_RX.hint: Create it with a buffer for what comes in, or with forwarding.

ERR_CONN_MIRROR_LOST.message: Stream {connector} of board {board} lost {count} frames on the way
